SELECT  
	AliasName=Acc.AliasName,
	Acc.Name, 
	IC.Icatcode, 
	Ic.Name,
	SaleMan = CASE :ar_smancode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL SALES PERSON' ELSE (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = :ar_smancode) END,

	saleqty=sum( (CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' then qty ELSE 0 END)),
	returnqty=sum( (CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'R' then qty ELSE 0 END)),

	grossvalue = ROUND(SUM(
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN
			P.grossvalue
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	discvalue = ROUND ( SUM ( 
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN
			ISNULL(P.itemdiscvalue,0) + ISNULL(P.invitemdiscvalue,0) +
									ISNULL(P.flatdisc,0) * ( ISNULL(P.itemvalue, 0) /
									CASE ISNULL(P.grossamt,0) WHEN 0 THEN 1 
									ELSE ISNULL(P.grossamt,0) END)
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	salevalue=ROUND(SUM(
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN
			ISNULL(P.itemvalue,0) - (ISNULL(P.flatdisc,0) *(ISNULL(P.itemvalue,0)/
			CASE ISNULL(P.grossamt,0) WHEN 0 THEN 1 
			ELSE ISNULL(P.grossamt,0) END))
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	returnval=ROUND(SUM(
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'R' THEN
			ISNULL(P.itemvalue,0) - (ISNULL(P.flatdisc,0) * (ISNULL(P.itemvalue,0)/
				CASE ISNULL(P.grossamt,0) WHEN 0 THEN 1 
				ELSE ISNULL(P.grossamt,0) END)) 
		ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM 
(
SELECT
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saledetail.icode,
	qty=SUM(saledetail.looseqty),
	GrossValue = SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice ) ,
	ItemDiscValue = ISNULL(SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
						 (.01 * saledetail.discperc) + saledetail.itemflatdisc ), 0),
	InvItemDiscValue = ISNULL(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
							(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc) ) *  (.01 * saleledger.discperc) ), 0),
	ItemValue=ISNULL(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * saleledger.discperc)),0),
	GrossAmt=
		(SELECT SUM((sd.looseqty*(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * sl.discperc)))
		FROM	saledetail sd, saleledger sl
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode and sl.saleinvcode=sd.saleinvcode
		GROUP BY sl.saleinvcode),
	flatdisc=ISNULL(saleledger.flatdisc, 0),
	catcode=saleledger.salecatcode,
	type='S',
	custcode = saleledger.custcode

FROM
	saleledger,	 
	saledetail,
	(SELECT CC.* FROM Customer CC 
	WHERE :ai_allcust=1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT CC.* FROM Customer CC
	WHERE :ai_allcust=0 AND CC.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode)) C
WHERE
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND 
	saleledger.date >= :ar_startdate AND saleledger.date <= :ar_enddate AND 
	saleledger.custcode = C.CustCode AND
	ISNULL(saleledger.smancode, -1) = ISNULL(CASE :ar_smancode WHEN -1 THEN saleledger.smancode ELSE :ar_smancode END, -1)

GROUP BY 
	 saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saledetail.icode,
	 saleledger.custcode,
	 saleledger.salecatcode,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.salecatcode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	saleledger.saleinvcode,

	qty=sum(saledetail.looseqty),

						 (.01 * saledetail.discperc) + saledetail.itemflatdisc ), 0),
	InvItemDiscValue = ISNULL(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
							(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc) ) *  (.01 * saleledger.discperc) ), 0),
	ItemValue=ISNULL(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * saleledger.discperc)),0),
	GrossAmt=

			(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * sl.discperc)))

WHERE
